title: Elizondo: 'Time is not a luxury that we can afford'
summary: Lou Elizondo tells of Elizondo: 'Time is not a luxury that we can afford', about mid-2020s to 2034 at United States (no place named), and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Time is not a luxury that we can afford. We we the time has come. We need to start having the conversation collectively.

plain: Lou Elizondo, a former US government official who speaks publicly about unexplained flying objects, appeared on a show hosted by the podcaster Jesse Michels and urged that the public conversation about them can't wait. In his words, "time is not a luxury that we can afford", and the time has come for everyone to start talking about it together. He says this because, if what he believes is true, people need to face the question of non-human intelligence now and not later.
